# Code Anchors: Scope Provenance

- `libs/scope-razor/src/offer.ts` — reads each story heading's own label and its quoted fragment, treating an unlabelled heading as model-added.
- `libs/scope-razor/src/check.ts` — blocks an item or a story heading carrying no label at all.
- `libs/scope-razor/src/citations.ts` — the citation half: the label grammar, the shared normalization, the four-word floor, and the containment test.
- `libs/scope-razor/src/citations.spec.ts` — pins the normalization slack, the word floor, and that a fragment absent from the source text fails.
- `components/skills/nxs-razor/SKILL.md` — the two-valued vocabulary at every granularity it reaches, the story heading included, and why a story's own label decides what the gate files.
- `components/commands/nxs.epic.md` — materializes the run's source text into session scratch before labelling anything, then labels every story heading, acceptance criterion, assumption and out-of-scope item.
- `components/commands/nxs.decision-record.md` — the same materialization and labelling over a record's invariants and risks.
- `libs/scope-razor/src/record-offer.ts` — reads each record invariant's and risk's label to decide whether it is the model's own and so listed at the checkpoint.
- `components/commands/nxs.discover.md` — the same over a discovery document and its tickets, with resolutions exempt.
